hook_text: Three kinds of sugar, three races, one stopwatch. Which sugar disappears first?
clip_script: Winter in Welkom. Race one: hot water against cold. Hot wins! Its particles move faster. Race two: stirred against still. Stirring wins! Fresh water reaches the sugar. Race three: a sugar cube, ordinary sugar, icing sugar. Icing sugar wins by miles! More surface touches the water. And the rule for every race: change only one thing. That's a fair test.
visual_style: Whiteboard race track with three heats, each showing two or three glasses and a stopwatch, with the winner circled.
mood: Competitive and fun, like sports day.
pacing: Three quick races with a winner each, then the fair test rule.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and run your own sugar race at home with an adult.
